verdict: Leads are up sharply, but none are converting to pipeline yet.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaign delivered 139 leads at a cost of $12.85 per lead — a 16.4% drop in cost per lead alongside a 29.73% jump in lead volume week-over-week, meaning the ads are working more efficiently with only a modest increase in spend. The problem is what happens after the lead arrives: zero opportunities have been created from those contacts, meaning leads are coming in but not moving forward into your intake pipeline. That gap is the priority right now, and we are working through the CRM and intake setup to close it. On the organic side, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this week; a content cadence is being put in place to stabilize that signal. You should expect the pipeline picture to improve as intake automation comes online in the coming weeks.
